direct_growth_rationale: Q1FY27 India volume13%, growth-business sales47%, tea pricing pass-through and international FX translation support a category mix forecast, not one group volume figure. Base growth12% fades to8%, while margin13.6% in Q1 gradually improves with integration and growth-business scale.

drivers.source: FY26 consolidated statements and latest result presentation

research_notes.finding: Q1FY27 India tea volume rose2% while revenue fell4% as costs were passed through. Growth businesses grew47% and represented36% of India revenue. Group growth is not a simple common volume multiplied by one price assumption.

Use balance-sheet cash INR3046.57cr and gross borrowings including overdrafts. Cash-flow closing cash INR1412.79cr already subtracts INR1633.78cr overdrafts. Using that net cash and deducting overdraft again would double count debt.

INR1330.90cr put/call purchase commitments concern fully consolidated subsidiaries with NCI. This case deducts reported INR1401.33cr NCI at carrying proxy and separately INR59.68cr contingent consideration. It does not deduct the put liability again. Contract-by-contract minority fair-value reconciliation is unresolved and could materially change equity value.

Equity-method results of negative INR90.70cr are excluded from operating EBIT. Associate/JV carrying values are added once in the bridge. Starbucks sales are not consolidated group revenue and are not assigned a standalone positive enterprise value without a segment model.

Low payout and continuing portfolio reinvestment make DDM a weak primary method. NAV omits brands. SOTP awaits separate regional/segment forecasts and matched peer evidence. P/E and EV/EBITDA are visible multiple stress cases with zero weight.
